details:
Command-line frontends for Sequoia.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * hickory-resolver: hickory-resolver: DNSSEC validation bypass allows forged DNS records (CVE-2026-93657)
  * rustls-webpki: rustls-webpki: Denial of Service via crafted Certificate Revocation List (CVE-2026-93599)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
